summary.text: Steve Huffman is serving his second term in the Ohio Senate for District 5, which includes all of Miami and Preble counties and portions of Butler, Darke, and Montgomery counties. He chairs the Senate Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Huffman earned a medical degree from the Medical College of Ohio (now the University of Toledo School of Medicine) after graduating from Milton-Union High School, and has been a practicing physician for 32 years.
He served two terms in the Ohio House from 2015 to 2018 and was Miami County Coroner from 2012 to 2015.
A lifelong resident of Miami County, he lives in Tipp City with his wife, Kathryn, and their five children.
